cohort: The study included all deliveries of Clalit Health Services-insured women at Soroka University Medical Center from 2005 to 2017.
finding: After adjustment for relevant confounders, including gestational age, there was no significant association between preeclampsia (mild or severe) and the cumulative incidence of autism spectrum disorder in offspring.
mod_finding: Preeclampsia, especially with severe features, was linked to adverse outcomes, including an increased rate of cesarean delivery.
